googleGuide.title: 連接 Google 帳號
googleGuide.sub: 直接前往 Google 登入授權，Gmail 和行事曆就會自動同步。
googleGuide.quickBody: 使用內建 OAuth 安全授權（PKCE S256），不需建立 Google Cloud 專案或手動複製權杖；授權憑證只加密保存在這台電腦。
googleGuide.quickScopes: 將要求授權：Gmail（讀取、封存、標為已讀）· Google 行事曆（讀取與新增你確認的行程）
googleGuide.clientBuiltin: 目前使用內建一鍵連線，直接按下方按鈕即可前往 Google 授權。
googleGuide.advancedSummary: 進階選項：自訂 Google Cloud 用戶端或手動貼上網址
googleGuide.clientReset: 已恢復內建 Google 一鍵連線
googleGuide.intro: 照順序做一次就好，大約 10 分鐘。每完成一步就勾起來，下次回來會記得做到哪裡。

project.title: 建立專案
project.why: Google Cloud 專案是放這個應用程式設定的地方，只有你自己會用到。
project.linkLabel: 開啟 Google Cloud 新增專案

apis.title: 啟用信件與行事曆 API
apis.why: 沒有啟用 API，授權之後也讀不到信件和行程。兩個都要啟用。

consent.title: 設定同意畫面（外部、正式版）
consent.why: 測試版授權 7 天失效；發布為正式版才免每週重連。首頁與隱私權網址填下方這兩個。

client.title: 建立網頁用戶端
client.why: 應用程式類型選「網頁應用程式」，Google 才會把你送回這台電腦。

redirect.title: 複製重新導向網址
redirect.why: 貼到用戶端的「已授權的重新導向 URI」，須完全一致，連字尾斜線都不能多。

secret.title: 下載用戶端密碼

googleGuide.copyFailed: 沒有複製到剪貼簿，請手動選取網址。

googleGuide.connectHint: 會前往 Google 登入並勾選權限；完成後自動回到這裡。

fallbackSteps.1: 在憑證頁面建立「電腦版應用程式」用戶端，把 ID 和密碼存到下面。
fallbackSteps.2: 按「用貼上網址連接」，在 Google 完成授權。
fallbackSteps.3: Google 導回的頁面打不開時，複製網址列的完整網址，貼到下面的欄位。

googleGuide.vaultOffBody: 用戶端密碼和授權暫時無法保存。請依部署說明完成設定後重新啟動服務。

googleGuide.title: Connect your Google account
googleGuide.sub: Sign in with Google directly so Gmail and Calendar sync automatically.
googleGuide.quickBody: Uses built-in PKCE S256 OAuth—no Google Cloud project or manual tokens needed. Your grant stays encrypted on this computer.
googleGuide.quickScopes: Requests access to: Gmail (read, archive, mark read) · Google Calendar (read and add events you confirm)
googleGuide.clientBuiltin: Using built-in Google sign-in. Click below to authorize right away.
googleGuide.advancedSummary: Advanced: Use a custom Google Cloud client or paste redirect URL
googleGuide.clientReset: Switched back to built-in Google sign-in
googleGuide.intro: Do this once in order—it takes about 10 minutes. Check off each step as you go; we'll save your progress.

project.title: Create a project
project.why: A Google Cloud project holds this app's settings, for your own use only.

apis.title: Enable Gmail & Calendar APIs
apis.why: Without both APIs enabled, BELL can't read your mail or calendar even after you sign in.

consent.title: Set consent screen (External, Production)
consent.why: Testing sign-ins expire after 7 days. Publish to production so you stay connected, using the two URLs below.

client.title: Create a web client
client.why: Pick "Web application" as the type so Google sends you back to this computer.

redirect.title: Copy the redirect URL
redirect.why: Paste this under "Authorized redirect URIs" so it matches character for character, with no trailing slash.

secret.title: Save your client ID and secret
secret.why: Paste the client ID and secret Google shows into the fields below. Your secret stays encrypted on this computer.

googleGuide.copyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically. Select and copy the URL by hand.
googleGuide.clientSavedHint: Client {hint} · Secret encrypted on this computer
googleGuide.clientFromServer: This server already provides a Google client in its config, so you don't need to enter one here.
googleGuide.connectHint: Opens Google to sign in and choose permissions, then brings you right back.
googleGuide.needClient: Save your client ID and secret first to connect.
googleGuide.fallbackIntro: Web clients need https. Use a "Desktop app" client instead, then copy and paste the redirect URL below.

fallbackSteps.1: On Credentials, create a "Desktop app" client and save its ID and secret below.
fallbackSteps.2: Click "Connect by pasting URL" and approve access in Google.
fallbackSteps.3: When the redirect page fails to load, copy the full URL from your address bar and paste it below.

googleGuide.vaultOff: Encryption isn't set up on this server yet, so secrets and sign-ins can't be saved. Finish setup and restart.
googleGuide.vaultOffBody: Secrets and sign-ins can't be saved on this server yet. Finish setup and restart.
googleGuide.offline: Can't reach the local service. Make sure BELL Personal is running.

clientSecret.invalid: Client secret must be at least 8 characters with no spaces.

pasteUrl.invalid: Paste the full URL from your address bar, including code=.

googleGuide.disconnectBody: Revokes access and clears cached mail and events here. Your client stays saved so you can reconnect anytime.
googleGuide.disconnectedLocal: Disconnected on this computer. Google didn't respond, so you can also remove access in your Google Account.
